e8bba596: What is Monkey D. Luffy's dream?
Luffy wants to become King of the Pirates by finding the legendary One Piece treasure left by Gol D. Roger.
2267d936: Which Devil Fruit did Luffy eat?
The Gum-Gum Fruit (Gomu Gomu no Mi) turns Luffy's body into rubber. It is actually the Human-Human Fruit, Model: Nika.
60c8dd05: Who is the first to join Luffy's crew?
Zoro is the first to join Luffy. He was held prisoner by Morgan when Luffy freed him in Shells Town.
1adbfd6f: What is the name of the Straw Hat crew's first ship?
The Going Merry is Luffy's first ship. It is later replaced by the Thousand Sunny, built by Franky.
86ebbc7e: Zoro uses Santōryū (Three-Sword Style), holding a sword in each hand and one in his mouth.
e80d3830: Draw a map of the whole world
Nami dreams of drawing a map of the entire world and sailing freely on every sea.
5646bf0e: The All Blue is the legendary sea where every fish in the world lives together. It is Sanji's ultimate dream.
10daea23: What is the reward placed on a pirate's head called?
A bounty is the reward the World Government places on a pirate's head, based on how dangerous they are. The berry is the currency of the One Piece world.
96b49ad0: Edward Newgate, known as Whitebeard, was one of the Four Emperors and was said to be the strongest man in the world.
ea9d85ad: Which Devil Fruit lets its user create and control light?
Admiral Kizaru's Pika Pika no Mi (a Logia) turns his body into light, moving at the speed of light.
fbbd5ca0: What is the name of Luffy's Gear 2 technique?
Gear Second speeds up Luffy's blood flow, boosting his speed and power at the cost of his stamina.
2192c842: Gol D. Roger was the captain of the Roger Pirates, which Shanks the Red belonged to as a boy.
956c3cd6: Which giants' homeland do Dorry and Brogy come from?
Elbaph is the legendary island of giant warriors that Usopp has dreamed of since childhood. Dorry and Brogy have been dueling for 100 years on Little Garden.
d741f5e3: What is Portgas D. Ace's Devil Fruit?
Ace had the Mera Mera no Mi (the fire Logia). After his death, Sabo obtains it in the Corrida Colosseum tournament.
6513530b: On which archipelago do crews prepare before diving to the New World?
The Sabaody Archipelago lies just before the Red Line. That is where crews prepare their descent to the bottom of the sea.
142564b3: What is the capital of the Kingdom of Alabasta?
Alubarna is Alabasta's royal capital, where the final battle against Crocodile and Baroque Works takes place.
1ab41b6b: Who is the main villain of the Alabasta arc?
Crocodile, one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea, used Baroque Works to destabilize and conquer Alabasta.
de10ce56: What is the name of the sky fortress in Mary Geoise?
Pangaea Castle in Mary Geoise is the seat of the World Government and the Five Elders.
667258d5: What is Trafalgar D. Water Law's Devil Fruit?
Law's Ope Ope no Mi creates a spherical zone (Room) in which he can manipulate and cut anything at will.
fbf7b3b4: What is the rarest kind of Haki in One Piece?
Conqueror's Haki is the rarest kind, held by one person in a million. It can knock out the weak-willed.
912fb664: What is the name of Vegapunk's team of scientists?
Vegapunk's Satellites are six embodied aspects of him: Shaka, Lilith, Edison, Pythagoras, Atlas and York.
37ac998a: Marshall D. Teach is the man who killed Thatch to steal his Devil Fruit and later captured Ace.
4264f593: What are the pirates who work for the World Government in exchange for immunity called?
The Seven Warlords of the Sea (Shichibukai) are pirates allied with the World Government in exchange for immunity.
f47bb20b: What is the name of the underwater prison for major criminals?
Impel Down is the hellish underwater prison divided into six levels based on the severity of the crimes. Luffy breaks in to free Ace.
d627ff1f: What is Big Mom's real name?
Charlotte Linlin is one of the Four Emperors. She rules Totto Land and her powerful Charlotte family.
0e7aea88: What is Big Mom's Devil Fruit?
Big Mom's Soru Soru no Mi lets her manipulate souls, extract them and give them to objects to create Homies.
ed8c16cb: In which village did Luffy grow up?
Foosha Village, on Dawn Island, is Luffy's home village. That is where he met Shanks.
f556942d: Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Serpent
Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Azure Dragon
Kaido ate the Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Azure Dragon (Seiryu), a Mythical Zoan that lets him turn into an azure dragon.
be04e593: What is the name of the island under the sea where the fish-men live?
Fish-Man Island lies 10,000 meters below the sea. It is home to the fish-men and the merfolk.
688c6635: Monkey D. Dragon is Luffy's father and the leader of the Revolutionary Army, the most wanted man in the world.
5c0534af: Zoro comes from Shimotsuki Village, where he learned swordsmanship at Koshiro's dojo.
95b58f22: What is the name of Whitebeard's right-hand man?
Marco the Phoenix is the commander of the 1st Division and Edward Newgate's right-hand man. He has a Mythical Zoan fruit.
fd8e0854: Who is the head of the Marines at the start of the series?
Sengoku the Buddha is the Fleet Admiral of the Marines for most of the original series.
5e694403: What power does Admiral Akainu's Devil Fruit give him?
Sakazuki (Akainu) has the Magu Magu no Mi, a magma Logia even more destructive than Ace's fire.
d4209180: Who is the mysterious woman serving as Baroque Works' vice president in Alabasta?
Under the name Miss All Sunday, Nico Robin was Crocodile's partner in Baroque Works. She later joins the crew as its archaeologist.
e8e1897f: What is Robin's power (Hana Hana no Mi)?
Sprouting copies of her body parts anywhere
The Hana Hana no Mi lets Robin sprout copies of her own body parts (arms, eyes and so on) on any surface.
a33ece73: What disguise does Usopp use during the Enies Lobby arc?
Usopp disguises himself as “Sogeking” during the Enies Lobby arc to help his friends incognito.
88f89b10: On which judicial island do the Straw Hats come to rescue Robin?
Enies Lobby is the World Government's judicial island, where major criminals are tried. The Straw Hats storm it to rescue Robin.
597715e8: Which pirate ate the Gura Gura no Mi (Tremor-Tremor Fruit)?
Whitebeard's Gura Gura no Mi can create world-shattering quakes. Blackbeard steals it after his death.
e3c722f0: What is Sanji's signature fighting style?
Sanji uses the Black Leg Style, a kick-based fighting style inherited from his mentor, the chef Zeff.
b7c0764d: What is the name of the Dressrosa arena hosting the tournament to win the Mera Mera no Mi?
The Corrida Colosseum is the Dressrosa arena where the tournament to win the Mera Mera no Mi takes place.
c8a34c68: What is the first arc set in the New World?
Punk Hazard is the first New World arc, an island ravaged by World Government science and Caesar Clown.
5bc193ff: Who is the Straw Hat Pirates' doctor?
Tony Tony Chopper is the crew's doctor. He is a reindeer who ate the Hito Hito no Mi, which lets him turn human.
f87dbe2e: Nami comes from Cocoyasi Village, where the fish-man Arlong ruled, making villagers pay for the right to live.
75211df4: Who is the most brilliant scientist in the One Piece world?
Dr. Vegapunk is the World Government's official scientific genius, creator of the Pacifistas and of artificial fruits.
2332261d: What is the name of the undersea palace on Fish-Man Island?
The Ryugu Kingdom is the royal undersea palace of Fish-Man Island, home of King Neptune and his children.
75ef4e35: What is the name of the ark-like ship at Fish-Man Island?
The Noah is a huge ship floating above Fish-Man Island, promised to carry the fish-men to the surface.
475a2c2c: Who are the three Marine Admirals after the time skip?
After the time skip, Akainu becomes Fleet Admiral. The three Admirals are then Kizaru (Borsalino), Fujitora (Issho) and Ryokugyu (Aramaki).
40b480f9: What is the name of Mihawk's legendary black blade?
Yoru is Dracule Mihawk's Supreme Grade sword, the greatest of the world's black blades.
9ce3abd3: What is the real name of the armor Haki in One Piece?
Busoshoku Haki (Armament Haki) coats the body or weapons in invisible armor, to counter Logias and deal more damage.
6fad661b: What type of Devil Fruit does Katakuri (Big Mom's son) have?
Katakuri's Mochi Mochi no Mi is a mochi Paramecia — it also gives him Logia-like abilities once he masters advanced Observation Haki.
057d6d6e: Red-Haired Shanks, one of the Four Emperors, owes his nickname to his red hair.
c8938d92: What is the Japanese name for the Seven Warlords of the Sea?
Shichibukai (Seven Warlords of the Sea) is the Japanese term — powerful pirates officially working for the World Government in exchange for immunity.
a7aebf1c: What is the Devil Fruit of Brook, the skeleton musician?
The Yomi Yomi no Mi (Revive-Revive Fruit) let Brook come back to life after death — a second life in his skeleton.
082e2505: What is the first form of Luffy's Gear Fourth called?
Boundman is the first form of Gear Fourth — Haki armor, inflated muscles, and multiplied speed and power against Doflamingo.
e55b52b0: What is Doflamingo's alias in the criminal underworld?
Joker is Doflamingo's underworld alias — he controls a criminal empire supplying weapons and SMILEs (artificial Zoans).
56498ab4: In which arc do Luffy and Law team up against Doflamingo?
Dressrosa is the arc where Luffy and Law bring down Doflamingo — freeing the human toys and revealing Doflamingo's crimes to King Riku.
0b466f3a: What is the mysterious hidden era erased by the World Government called?
The Void Century is a 100-year period erased from the records — only the Poneglyphs keep a trace of it. The World Government actively censors it.
7c8e36d6: What is Luffy's ultimate power linked to the “Sun God” called?
Gear Fifth is the awakening of the Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika — Luffy becomes the Warrior of Liberation, with a body that behaves like living rubber.
